queries.unsettled_runs: SELECT count(*) AS count FROM domain_objects WHERE kind='Run' AND coalesce(json_extract(body,'$.status'),'UNKNOWN') NOT IN ('SETTLED','FAILED','CANCELLED')
queries.unsettled_effects: SELECT count(*) AS count FROM resource_effects x WHERE sequence=(SELECT max(y.sequence) FROM resource_effects y WHERE y.project=x.project AND y.run=x.run AND y.effect_key=x.effect_key) AND json_extract(body,'$.state') IN ('PREPARED','STARTED','UNKNOWN')
queries.unsettled_dispatches: SELECT count(*) AS count FROM runtime_dispatches WHERE state IN ('PREPARED','STARTED','UNKNOWN')
queries.managed_unsettled: SELECT count(*) AS count FROM idempotency i LEFT JOIN domain_objects r ON r.project=i.project AND r.kind='Run' AND r.id=json_extract(i.body,'$.run_ref.id') WHERE i.operation='host:managed-runtime-qualification' AND (r.id IS NULL OR coalesce(json_extract(r.body,'$.status'),'UNKNOWN') NOT IN ('SETTLED','FAILED','CANCELLED') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM runtime_dispatches d WHERE d.project=i.project AND d.run=r.id AND d.state IN ('PREPARED','STARTED','UNKNOWN')) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM resource_effects x WHERE x.project=i.project AND x.run=r.id AND x.sequence=(SELECT max(y.sequence) FROM resource_effects y WHERE y.project=x.project AND y.run=x.run AND y.effect_key=x.effect_key) AND json_extract(x.body,'$.state') IN ('PREPARED','STARTED','UNKNOWN')))

not_checked: in-memory coordinator worker map and quiesce flags
